{{Quote|The push was orchestrated by the Ulgos, to distract us from something they're calling Operation Sun Shower.|[[Craige Graf]]|<ref name="TOR:PES">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Pre-Emptive Strike|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
'''Operation Sun Shower''' was a military initiative created during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by [[House Ulgo]]. It involved the use of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] detonator against [[House of Thul|House Thul]]. To cover their plan, this [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] family used [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] against Thul mines to distract them from this planned operation. To secure its transportation, an elite group of Ulgo [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that were former [[Republic Special Forces Division]] were used to transport the detonator to the site.

[[Stanel Andaren Thul]] learnt of the plot and tasked an agent from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] with dealing with this threat.
